rationale: The position is near its take-profit target ($18.55) with only 58 minutes remaining in the session, and the recent 1-minute candle shows a rejection from the intraday high ($18.50) back to $18.47, suggesting short-term momentum is stalling. Closing now would lock in a modest gain but forfeit the remaining upside potential if the price reclaims the high, while flipping to short is premature given the price remains above the 9-EMA and session VWAP. Holding allows the automatic take-profit to execute if the price pushes higher, or the invalidation to protect capital if the reversal fails.
